senses.gloss: m. (בהק) one afflicted with bohak (Lev. XIII, 39), one having an eruption resembling leprosy, v. בּוֹהַק.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 98:5">Gen. R. s. 98</cite> <he>מי שהוא ב׳ וכ׳</he> one who is a bahakan is hot-tempered. Pl. <he>בָּהֲקָנִין</he>.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 98:5">Ib.</cite> (ed. <he>בּוֹהֲ׳</he>) <he>ריבה בהן ב׳</he> (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 49:7">Gen. XLIX, 7</cite>) he let rise among them a large number of bohakanin (hot-tempered men). V. <cite ref="B00189">next w.</cite>
